description:
Seeking a Senior IT Developer, Enterprise Service Bus (ESB)
This position is for an experienced IS professional to provide technical expertise in Integration Services Team. 
The team is responsible for full life-cycle delivery of integration solutions in a service oriented Enterprise Service Bus environment. 
The position requires a Senior developer with deep experience in Service Oriented Architecture and Enterprise Service Bus concepts and implementation, and who has skills and experience needed to lead activities to ensure integration solutions are performance tested and tuned properly before each release.


 5+ years’ experience in Information Technology
Previous experience in an IS Strong experience with the TIBCO SOA stack (TIBCO Active Matrix Business Works v5.12 and/or v6, TIBCO Enterprise Message Service, and TIBCO Active Matrix Business Works Plug-ins for REST and JSON, Database, WebSphere MQ) 
Experience with Tibco Active Spaces and or Business Events preferred. 
Technology lead role is preferred. Strong knowledge of SOA concepts and experience with web services, integration and Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) technologies is a must
Familiar with SOAP and REST services.
Experience using Liaison Contivo (xml mapping tool), or similar tools
Working knowledge of high availability and clustering concepts and implementation
Telecommunications BSS/OSS systems experience a plus
NGOSS/SID knowledge a plus


 Raj Eslavath 
 408-724-9765
